lead: A deep, fabric-safe clean that lifts out body oils, dust, and spills, gentle enough for delicate upholstery.
cardDescription: Sofas, sectionals, chairs, and mattresses deep-cleaned safe for the fabric, and left soft to the touch.
homeDescription: Sofas, chairs, and cushions cleaned gently so they look and smell fresh.

whatsIncluded.label: Fabric check & spot test
whatsIncluded.description: I check the fabric type and test a hidden spot so the clean is safe for your piece.

whatsIncluded.label: Warm-water extraction
whatsIncluded.description: Draws body oils, dust, and spills out from deep within the fabric.

whatsIncluded.label: Fabric-safe deodorizing
whatsIncluded.description: A gentle deodorizer leaves it smelling clean, never heavy or perfumed.

whatsIncluded.label: Dries soft
whatsIncluded.description: Careful rinsing avoids leaving cushions stiff or crunchy, so they're soft and usually ready the same day.

faq.a: Usually 4 to 6 hours with good airflow. Thick cushions can take a little longer than carpet.

faq.q: Is it safe for my fabric?
faq.a: I test a hidden spot first and match the method to the fabric. Delicate pieces get a gentler clean.

faq.q: Can you get pet smells out?
faq.a: Most of the time, yes. For heavy pet odor I'll add an enzyme treatment and tell you what to expect.
I clean and condition finished leather too. It's a different process, so just mention it when you request your estimate.
